name: A Pilot's Revenge
summary: Hildelve’s search ends in the crags of Dun Morogh, where Pilot Hammerfoot’s searchers find him frozen beside his journal. His last words call for vengeance.

sections.title: A Final Entry
sections.body: Hildelve’s journal tells of his savage fight with Mangeclaw, the huge Ice Claw bear. He drove the beast away at first, but his wounds were grave. Mangeclaw returned and killed him.

sections.title: A Pilot's Dying Wish
sections.body: Hildelve’s final plea calls for vengeance against Mangeclaw. Bring his journal and a claw torn from the beast to Pilot Hammerfoot. The grim news gives the Ironforge Siege Brigade closure and honors its lost comrade.

faq.answer: Pilot Hildelve was a dwarven siege engine pilot in the Ironforge Siege Brigade. When his engine broke down, he set out on foot into the mountains of Dun Morogh. His friend Pilot Hammerfoot sent searchers, who found Hildelve’s remains in the snow.
Mangeclaw is an exceptionally large and ferocious Ice Claw bear roaming the slopes of Dun Morogh. The bear ambushed Pilot Hildelve and wounded him mortally. Then Mangeclaw returned and killed him.

Pilot Hammerfoot is a seasoned siege engine pilot stationed in Dun Morogh and a member of the Ironforge Siege Brigade. Concerned for his missing friend Hildelve, he sends you into the wilds to learn what happened.

faq.q: Why does Hildelve's death matter to Ironforge?
faq.answer: The Ironforge Siege Brigade relies on trained pilots and machinery to scout and defend the mountainous territory around the capital. Hildelve’s death is a harsh blow to its ranks.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
aliases: how to start a pilot's revenge
faq.answer: Pilot Hammerfoot begins the journey by asking you to find his missing friend in “The Lost Pilot.” Finding Hildelve’s corpse begins “A Pilot’s Revenge.”

faq.q: What proof do you need to bring to Hammerfoot?
faq.answer: Bring Hildelve’s Journal from the pilot’s corpse and a Mangy Claw taken from Mangeclaw’s carcass. Together, they prove the beast was slain.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you honor Hildelve’s memory by avenging your fallen Ironforge Siege Brigade comrade and punishing his killer.
As an Alliance member, you know the Ironforge pilots are vital to dwarven and Alliance defenses. Recovering lost pilots is an essential duty.
As a hunter, you test your mountain survival skills by tracking an unusually vicious alpha beast like Mangeclaw through Dun Morogh’s freezing winds.
